descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name referring to Onan, the second son of Judah and a Canaanite woman (Genesis 38). English 'Onan / and–Onan / to–Onan,' Spanish 'Onan / Onán / y–Onan / a–Onan,' Hindi 'ओनान / और–ओनान / ओनान–से,' Arabic 'أُونَانُ / وَ–أُونَانُ / لِ–أُونَان,' Korean '오난 / 오난이라 / 그리고–오난,' Swahili 'Onani / na–Onani / kwa–Onani.' The two clusters differ only in whether the name appears with a conjunctive prefix or standalone/prepositional; the referent is identical throughout.
